results.title: Release History - The Go Programming Language
results.content:
Release History

This page summarizes the changes between official stable releases of Go. The change log has the full details.

go1.27 (released 2026-08-12)

Go 1.27 is a major release of Go. Read the Go 1.27 Release Notes for more information.

results.title: Go 1.27 is out
results.author: Sam Lee
results.content: The Go team released Go 1.27 today with iterator improvements and a faster garbage collector.
